They will be the next to join us.|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Pyke Syndicate''', also known as the '''Pyke family''', was an organization of [[Pyke/Legends|Pyke]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]]. Their leader, [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], allied them with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The Pyke family would prove useful to Maul in the subsequent [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], a short time after Lom Pyke joined Maul and the collective.

It was revealed that [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] sent [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] and [[Silman/Legends|Silman]] on a secret mission to deal with the Pyke Syndicate on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] Oba Diah.

After the fragmentation of the Shadow Collective, the Pyke Syndicate sought to expand their power by incorporating many smaller groups into their cartel, and they continued to persist in their trade despite the increased security of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Under a Black Sun">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref>
